notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content: Hello All. Once again thank you for playing my first title on Steam. This patch contains a fix that wasn't allowing players to open the game, as well as a fix for the achievements.

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content: A hotfix has been implemented to adjust the Steam Achievements. Achievement number 2 should be working properly now, and shouldn't unlock alongside Achievement 1. If the issue persists, another hotfix will be deployed in the future! Thank you all for playing!
